title: Aces High
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Aces High”, a luxury 7-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 14 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Gulf Views & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private Pool - (Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day from October 1 - May 1) -Amazing Gulf Views -Private Beach Access -Elevator -Six Seater Golf Cart Included -6 bikes included Aces High is a brand new construction 7 bedroom home located directly on 30A in the heart of Seagrove. This home features a private heated pool and deeded private beach access directly across the street. Upon entering the home there are two king bedrooms and one queen bedroom, each with their own private bathroom. The second floor opens up to the main living area as well as the kitchen and dining area. The master bedroom is also located on the second floor. The remaining three bedrooms with private baths are located on the third floor.
